D/ IMP LICINIVS P F AVG ; R/ GENIO-POP ROM

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Licinius, dating to c. AD 310-312 (Reece period 15). Reverse: GENIO POP ROM. Unclear Mint. Pierced to right of forehead. Obverse description: Laureate and cuirassed bust facing right. Obverse inscription: IMP LICINIVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Genius standing left, holding patera and cornucopiae. Reverse inscription: GENIO-POP ROM. Diameter: 30.09 mm; Thickness: 2.49 mm; Weight: 9.18g
